criteria.name: 1 promos need the customer's opt-in, reminders and critical messages do not
criteria.label: outcome

criteria.name: 2 quiet hours follow the customer's own window and zone, critical messages ignore them
criteria.label: outcome

criteria.name: 3 at most three non-critical messages in any rolling 24 hours, critical ones neither count nor wait
criteria.label: outcome

criteria.name: 4 when the cap leaves fewer slots than candidates, higher priority goes first, in that order
criteria.label: outcome

criteria.name: 5 the same dedupe key is not repeated within seven days or twice in one batch
criteria.label: outcome

criteria.name: 6 every candidate is sent or dropped exactly once, and each reason has its own non-empty rule
criteria.label: outcome
